The Guardian NigeriaNews feature5 May 2025

Anzolo Kpazhi Hope: Leading Nigeria’s AI drive through GlemVNT

David Meshioye’s feature connects my work through GlemVNT and Falzz with business adoption and technology education. I appreciate the attention it gives to making technology useful beyond a demonstration.

Today, I carry that practical focus into ECHUKU: understanding a business problem, designing the workflow and helping people use the system. This is my reflection on the coverage, not a claim that the newspaper assessed today’s products.

THISDAYNews feature11 August 2025

Anzolo Kpazhi Hope: Leading a Continent to the Global Table with Indigenous Digital Tools

THISDAY’s feature follows the role of collaboration in my earlier work through GlemVNT. It discusses business and education relationships, including the Meat Mill and TAKTAL.

I am grateful for coverage that gives people and adoption a place in the technology story. My continuing question at ECHUKU is how to turn an introduction or training session into a workflow somebody can use. The original report records its own time; it is not a current audit of each partnership.
